text:
[Council File 26-1398]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND JOBS COMMITTEE REPORT relative to instructing the Community Investment Department (CID), with the assistance of the Civil + Human Rights and Equity Department (CHRED) and the Department on Disability (DoD), to report to Council with recommendations to develop and fund workforce development programs for neurodivergent residents; and related matters.
Recommendations for Council action, pursuant to Motion (Hutt - Jurado, Soto-Martinez):
INSTRUCT the CID, with the assistance of the CHRED and the DoD to report to Council in 60 days with recommendations to develop and fund workforce development programs for neurodivergent residents. The recommendations should consider funding from the Workforce Investment Board, Community Development Block Grant, and any other workforce-related eligible funding the department receives.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
For: statement Los Feliz Neighborhood Council
summary: Council instructs the Community Investment Department, with help from the Civil + Human Rights and Equity and Disability departments, to report within 60 days with recommendations for developing and funding workforce programs for neurodivergent residents.
